newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said it has qualified for bond insurance the following eight municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--West Boylston, Mass., $8.2 million of unlimited tax bonds.
--Fort Zumwalt S.D., Mo., $5 million school bonds.
--Cabarrus County, N.C., $49 million of GO bonds.
--Port Authority of New York and New Jersey $150 million of consolidated bonds, series 108, and $150 million consolidated bonds, series 109.
--Indiana Area School District, Pa., $9.2 million of GO bonds.
--Washington County, Utah, $9.9 million public safety GOs.
